subject: Closure checklist — signers, SLA exception request & day-one handover
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@horizonretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@horizonretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Closure checklist — signers, SLA exception request & day-one handover

Hi Elena / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive evaluation sessions — attached is the latest mutual action plan (MAP_Horizon_v3.pdf) with the final milestones we discussed. Two quick items we need to lock this week so we can meet the proposed start window:

1) Final Go/No-Go signoff: procurement requests the decision by EOD Friday (2025-06-13). Are your execs comfortable with that cadence?

2) Signers & signature flow: proposed signer set below — we plan to route via DocuSign (link to follow). Please confirm who will sign on Horizon's side.
   - Contracting: Tom Shields (CFO) — primary signatory
   - Legal countersign: in-house counsel (if required)

3) SLA exception: Horizon requested a short-term SLA exception for a 48-hour support response during the first two weeks of ramp. We can approve but Legal needs to accept the limited indemnity language change.

4) Start date options: earliest Monday 2025-07-07 (preferred) or a soft start 2025-07-14 if your procurement timeline runs long. We can run a 3-day pilot (limited volume) before full production.

Attachments: MAP_Horizon_v3.pdf, SOC2_report_Q4_2024.pdf

Next steps: If you confirm the signer list and Day-0 acceptance slot by Friday AM we will issue the DocuSign envelope and circulate the redline for legal.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

----
Note: I included Marissa (CS) and Kimberly (Legal) on Cc so they can jump in on the SLA exception and onboarding handoff notes.

From: Elena Park <elena.park@horizonretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonretail.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Closure checklist — signers, SLA exception request & day-one handover

Hi Jordan —

Thanks — received the MAP and SOC2 report. Quick answers:

- EOD Friday decision is tight but doable; I'll confirm with Tom by Thursday lunchtime.
- Primary signer will be Tom Shields (CFO). Our GC may do a courtesy review but is unlikely to countersign.
- The 48-hour support response SLA exception is acceptable provided we have clear escalation paths; procurement will want the exception captured in an appendix rather than the main indemnity clause.
- Preferred start date would be 2025-07-14 to give our onboarding team one extra week, but we can aim for 2025-07-07 if we get signoff by Friday.

Also: Procurement asked for a DocuSign envelope and a redline of the master services agreement (MSA). If you can circulate redlines to procurement and our GC it will speed review.

Elena
Elena Park
Head of Retail Operations | Horizon Retail
elena.park@horizonretail.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Closure checklist — need legal ok for SLA exception + redline requested

Kimberly / Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding Elena's reply. Key asks from Horizon: 1) approve a temporary SLA exception (48h response for ramp weeks 1–2) captured in an appendix, 2) produce a redline of the MSA for procurement, and 3) prepare the DocuSign envelope with signer roles (Tom Shields primary).

Karthik — can you prepare the DocuSign draft (including discount terms we discussed) and share the envelope link?
Marissa — plan for a 3-day pilot and quickhand onboarding checklist for Day-0; will need CS resources the week of 7/7 or 7/14 depending on signature timing.
Kimberly — please review the proposed appendix language below (simple scope/time-limited SLA). If legal is agreeable we can accept the appendix in lieu of changing the main indemnity paragraph.

Proposed appendix text (high level):
- Temporary ramp SLA: Redwood will provide a 48-hour P1 response during Ramp Week 1–2. After Ramp Week 2, Redwood will revert to standard SLA. This exception is limited to onboarding activities and does not expand indemnity.

We need a legal thumbs-up by EOD Thursday so procurement can greenlight Friday decision.

Thanks —
Jordan

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Closure checklist — legal redline and SLA appendix

Jordan / team —

Reviewed the proposed appendix. Legal is comfortable with a temporary SLA addendum on the following conditions:

1) The exception explicitly states "limited to onboarding activities" and expires 14 calendar days after Go-live.
2) Audit log retention remains at 12 months (we cannot shorten retention for this customer).
3) We will not modify the core indemnity language; any requester language that appears to expand indemnity will be removed.

I've attached a redlined MSA (Redline_Contract_Horizon_v2.docx) showing the appendix inserted as Section 12.6 and a short comment set for procurement on the indemnity language. Procurement should be able to accept with these constraints.

If procurement asks for a price concession because of the exception, we can offer a one-time credit (not a contract amendment) — suggest $5,000 credit applied to first invoice. Karthik, please confirm if that aligns with the deal economics.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

  - Pilot (3 days): 2025-07-07 to 2025-07-09 (limited traffic, CS-led)
  - Full go-live: Monday 2025-07-14 (if pilot successful)

Please confirm the signer for the DocuSign envelope and who will be the GC contact for a quick courtesy review. Once Tom signs we will countersign the same day and share the onboarding calendar for CS.
